northStar: A programmer with an existing React+Tailwind page can select a region, state intent (zh/en), see a proposal, reject with no residue, or accept with undo, without corrupting business logic or silently overwriting user edits.

findings.title: agentBatchApply silently overwrites uncommitted user edits
findings.fixDirection: Validate baseRef and content hashes before any write. Refuse the whole batch on conflict. Do not copy over a main-tree file that diverged from baseRef unless it already matches the worktree.
findings.acceptance: A concurrent user edit of a batch-touched file makes apply fail with BATCH_CONFLICT and leaves the user bytes intact (R09). Dirty trees are rejected at create or folded into the batch base (R08).

findings.title: Non-atomic apply; missed committed Agent changes; rename and Chinese paths
findings.fixDirection: Diff against baseRef plus the live worktree using git -z. Include committed worktree changes. Treat rename as delete+write. Apply through a recoverable transaction that rolls back earlier files if a later write fails.
findings.acceptance: Committed worktree files appear on apply (R10). A staged rename removes the old name (R11). A Chinese filename applies without JSON.parse of Git quotes (R12). Failure on a later file restores the earlier file (R17). Unchanged-root new batch files still apply (CONTROL).

findings.title: Checkpoint shared refs pollute Rewind
findings.fixDirection: Deep-copy store and source overlay on push, rewind, and fromJSON. History must not alias live nodes.
findings.acceptance: Mutating a live node after push leaves the stored checkpoint unchanged (R02). fromJSON must not alias the object that was passed in (R03).

findings.title: Source undo missing before-image and create-delete tombstone
findings.fixDirection: On first touch, capture the original bytes or a null tombstone. Checkpoints store the full session overlay including deletions. Rewind restores writes and deletes.
findings.acceptance: Creating a file then rewind removes it. Deleting a pre-existing file then rewind restores it. npm test covers this path.

findings.title: pathJail symlink escape
findings.fixDirection: realpath the existing prefix, then jail against the real project root. Reject any path whose real location is outside the root.
findings.acceptance: ../ is rejected and in-root paths resolve (CONTROL pathJail). A symlink that points outside the project cannot be used to read or write outside the root (R01).

findings.title: approve:true from the model is not authorization
findings.fixDirection: Deny destructive tools by default. Honor approve only on a trusted host/UI channel. autoApprove remains an operator setting. Ignore model-supplied approve.
findings.acceptance: executeTool from the model channel with approve:true is denied. Preview /api/tool is the host channel. npm test covers both.

findings.title: Three split states (preview / plugin / FlatStore)
findings.fixDirection: One ProjectRuntime with projectId and version shared by UI and Agent. Hydrate refuses a stale whole-canvas overwrite. Preview opens a real project path, not only test-fixtures.
findings.acceptance: status() and canvas JSON share projectId/version. POST /api/canvas with an older version is rejected. npm run preview binds OPENDESIGNER_PROJECT_ROOT or examples/programmer-page.

findings.title: applyToProject only writes canvas.json
findings.fixDirection: Split labels. 保存设计稿 writes the working copy. 应用到工程 runs only when real file diffs are shown and applied through the conflict-checked transaction.
findings.acceptance: The preview no longer labels canvas-only save as Apply. 应用到工程 is disabled when there are no file diffs.

findings.title: AI UX hardcodes Add shadow-lg
findings.fixDirection: Remove the demo instruction. Shadow/color/drag stay local ops. Model path proposes a scoped ChangeSet. Accept applies with a checkpoint. Reject leaves no residue. Gate the model button when no live provider is configured.
findings.acceptance: The preview does not call AI with Add shadow-lg to the button className. Propose/accept/reject is visible. A gated button is disabled rather than lying.

findings.title: Autosave failure clears dirty
findings.fixDirection: Require Response.ok and result.success. Keep dirty on failure so the next tick retries.
findings.acceptance: A failed autosave leaves dirty true. A successful autosave clears it.

findings.title: Claim release deletes a newer index; parent and child can both be live
findings.fixDirection: Release only clears the element index when it still points at that claim. Claiming an ancestor or descendant of a live claim is a conflict.
findings.acceptance: Releasing an expired claim does not erase a newer live lock (R13). Ancestor and descendant cannot be claimed by two owners (R14). A second claim on the same element is still rejected (CONTROL).

findings.title: Document graph missing validation
findings.fixDirection: Reject missing parents, cycles, and dangling page roots on attach, hydrate, and delete.
findings.acceptance: Attaching to an absent parent fails without corrupting the tree (R04). Cyclic hydrate is rejected before traversal (R15). Deleting a page root drops that page metadata (R16).

findings.title: jsx-svg is treated as visual proof
findings.fixDirection: Bind take_screenshot to a real sandbox HTML render. jsx-svg never records verification.
findings.acceptance: screenshotMode jsx-svg returns kind jsx-svg and visualProof false and does not unlock a mutated claim. html-render is bound to ComponentSandbox output.

findings.title: Adding grow deletes shrink-0
findings.fixDirection: Give flex grow and shrink distinct Tailwind slots. flex-1/auto/none stay a third slot.

findings.title: Upper-left and upper-right radius collapse
findings.fixDirection: Match rounded-tl/tr/bl/br before rounded-t/b/l/r so each corner is its own slot.

findings.title: Left border color dies when right border color is edited
findings.fixDirection: Slot border-l/r/t/b colors separately from each other and from widths.

findings.title: Tailwind merge false-deletes independent tokens
findings.fixDirection: Same slot table as OD-14..16. Do not treat unrelated prefixes as one category.
findings.acceptance: R05, R06, and R07 stay green together. Deterministic className edits do not drop sibling tokens.

findings.title: ComponentSandbox is not a sandbox
findings.fixDirection: Allowlist tags, attributes, and URL protocols. Render canvas HTML inside an iframe with CSP. Serve only preview.html, preview/, and lib/ from the preview server.
findings.acceptance: javascript: href is stripped. iframe+CSP wraps canvas HTML. Paths under src/ are 403 from the preview server.
